sections.title: Intel Core Series 2 Accelerates Single-Node Integration for Industrial Edge AI
sections.lead: Intel Core Series 2 resolves trade-offs in traditional x86 platforms for real-time and AI workloads, enabling single-node operations in factories and robotics. At Embedded World 2026, the Edge AI Suite for healthcare AI monitoring was also previewed.
